decisions.family: Expanded teacher population and phase registry
decisions.required_resolution: Exact teacher-seed roster, training rule for added teachers, per-seed phase selection, unavailable-cell rule, and matched-primary eligibility.
decisions.working_direction: Expand beyond five predecessor seeds, targeting approximately 15 matched teachers if prospectively constructible.

decisions.required_resolution: Exact architecture roster, initialization rules, parameter/component accounting, and balanced sparse assignment.
decisions.working_direction: Canonical matched architecture plus a systematic panel of up to five architecture families for external validity.

decisions.required_resolution: Hard and soft targets, losses, optimizers, schedules, stopping, tolerances, argmax rules, attempt caps, eligible target, replacement rule, and missing-cell minimum.
decisions.working_direction: Retain exact hard eligibility, gauge-invariant soft matching, unconditional failure accounting, and no imputation.

decisions.required_resolution: Canonical basis, attention-coordinate definition, seeded balanced neuron blocks, orthogonal rotations, intervention semantics, assignment, and weighted/type-stratified summaries.
decisions.working_direction: Test a limited predeclared set of granularity and orientation changes rather than claim universal basis invariance.

decisions.required_resolution: Formula implementation, precision, denominator guard, primary threshold, frontier grid, and ledger-reuse rule.
decisions.working_direction: One primary centred-logit setting plus a prospectively declared fidelity frontier.

decisions.required_resolution: Endpoint 2 status, component cap, overlap metric/cutoff, packing solver, censoring, and permitted claims.
decisions.working_direction: Endpoint 1 primary; packing key secondary unless preproduction validation justifies co-primary status.

decisions.required_resolution: Inherited method version, algorithmically distinct continuous/stochastic method, native budgets, common exact allowance, restarts, termination, failure, and backend determinism.
decisions.working_direction: At least two genuinely different discovery families with primarily within-method interpretation.

decisions.required_resolution: Combinatorial, ordinary-restart, local-perturbation, and feasible-region null algorithms, draw counts, budgets, and minimum reportable coverage.
decisions.working_direction: Use all four layers because they answer different questions.

decisions.required_resolution: Calibration task/model, mask universe, exact or near-exact algorithm, stopping certificate, and transfer limitations.
decisions.working_direction: Calibrate search suboptimality and feasible packing on a deliberately small instance.

decisions.required_resolution: Primary contrasts, student-cell summary, realization dispersion, architecture/basis/method factors, population model, missing-cell rule, failure tables, figures, and outcome-category resolution.
decisions.working_direction: Paired teacher-seed inference with raw seed values and unconditional attempt accounting.

decisions.required_resolution: Pair selection, layer/location, alignment, information-capacity match, outcomes, trial roster, all controls, and success criterion.
decisions.working_direction: Registered key secondary executed regardless of the primary result direction.

decisions.required_resolution: Protected Tier 1 matrix, protected Tier 2 minimum, optional Tier 3 list, balance rules, partial-completion interpretation, and fixed shedding order.
decisions.working_direction: Sparse tiered crossing; no literal full factorial and no duplication of ledger-derived reducer settings.

decisions.required_resolution: CPU/CUDA qualification, permitted numerical drift, resume equivalence, environment lock, resource classes, and abort rule.
decisions.working_direction: Definitive execution on qualified CPU/CUDA workers; prior MPS evidence remains technical only unless separately qualified.

decisions.required_resolution: Dependency DAG, concurrency, isolation, retries, compact formats, scratch/persistent quotas, monitoring, three human gates, final audit window, and verified export.
decisions.working_direction: One automated campaign with launch, primary-completeness, and exit gates.
